correctness.rationale: The complete RESULT, primary transfer/energy proof, angular range proof, both low-degree appendices, and Proposition 6.3 statement and proof were inspected. At lambda=1/2 the strict transfer path has positive coefficient and 0<N*theta<2*pi. Weak energy endpoints are strict; strong energy has 320/429<3/4; the remaining degree-six chord has 406/625<13/20; Appendix A shows strictly positive H4 and H5. Proposition 4.1 supplies both parameters k and k+1 in every cell k>=3. In the first two cells, the strict high-degree bounds and all low-degree factors were checked: degree five in the negative part of cell two uses strictly increasing J with J(1/3)=0. Hence every asserted minimizer multiplicity, including the unique 1,2,5 tie, follows. The detailed equality proof is archived separately.

final_claim: In the Legendre endpoint of the ultraspherical lower-envelope problem, each open cell has a unique minimizing degree, each ordinary breakpoint has exactly the adjacent minimizing pair, and the sole non-adjacent tie is \(P_1(-1/3)=P_2(-1/3)=P_5(-1/3)\); this triple is the unique Legendre obstruction to arbitrary-minimizer monotonicity.
